title: わからなくて、ごめんね
theme: 失敗しても同じ声で教えてくれた「そっか」が、子犬の安心になった

slides.text:
はじめての日、ぼくが
震えていた理由
slides.scene: A tiny puppy sits frozen on a wooden floor of a new apartment, trembling, ears back, looking up at the viewer with big worried eyes; a small wet spot on the floor right beside it.
slides.shot: centered, the puppy clearly visible at floor level

slides.text:
ここに来た日のこと、
覚えてる？
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, walks into a bright apartment carrying a small pet carrier; the tiny puppy peeks out of the carrier's front door toward the room.
slides.shot: from behind the owner at the entrance

slides.text:
においも、音も、
ぜんぶはじめてだった
slides.scene: The tiny puppy sniffs a houseplant pot and the leg of a sofa in a new living room, nose low to the floor, curious.
slides.shot: low angle at floor level

slides.text:
ふかふかの床が
うれしくて走りまわった
slides.scene: The tiny puppy runs happily across a soft rug in the living room, ears flying, all paws in motion.
slides.shot: low angle, the puppy running toward the right

slides.text:
そしたら、
やってしまったんだ
slides.scene: The tiny puppy stops mid-run on the wooden floor, looking down at a small puddle it just made beside its paws, surprised.
slides.shot: close-up at floor level, the puddle next to the puppy's paws

slides.text:
床にできた、
小さな水たまり
slides.scene: Close-up of a small puddle on the wooden floor with tiny paw prints leading away from it toward the puppy, who is peeking back at it.
slides.shot: close-up of the floor, the puppy small in the background

slides.text:
あなたの「あっ」という声に、
ぼくは固まった
slides.scene: The tiny puppy freezes with one paw lifted, looking up and to the side toward the owner's legs standing a few steps away (grey pants, socks).
slides.shot: low angle, the owner's legs at the edge of the frame, the puppy looking at them

slides.text:
怒られる。
そう思って、震えていた
slides.scene: Show a small puppy crouched low with its tail tucked and ears flattened, trembling and looking up fearfully. Place the owner standing in front of the puppy (in the direction the dog's body points), facing down toward the dog so the puppy is clearly looking up at the owner.
slides.shot: close-up of the puppy at floor level

slides.text:
でもあなたは、
しゃがんでぼくを見た
slides.scene: The owner crouches down on the floor facing the puppy, seen from behind the owner's shoulder; the puppy in front of the owner looks up at them.
slides.shot: from behind the owner's shoulder, the puppy facing the owner

slides.text:
「そっか、まだ
わからないよね」
slides.scene: The owner's open hand rests gently on the floor near the puppy, palm up; the puppy sniffs the fingers, ears relaxing.
slides.shot: close-up of the hand and the puppy's nose

slides.text:
あなたは床をふいて、
トイレの場所を見せてくれた
slides.scene: The owner's hands place the puppy onto a pet toilet tray with a pad in the corner of the room, near a cloth used to wipe the floor.
slides.shot: close-up of hands, puppy and toilet tray

slides.text:
何回まちがえても、
同じ声で教えてくれた
slides.scene: Several days: the owner, seen from behind kneeling, points gently at the toilet tray while the puppy sits beside it listening.
slides.shot: from behind the owner, the puppy next to the tray

slides.text:
そして三日目、
ぼくはちゃんとできた
slides.scene: The tiny puppy stands proudly on the toilet tray pad, tail up, looking back over its shoulder at the owner who is behind it.
slides.shot: low angle, the owner's knees behind the puppy

slides.text:
あなたは、
びっくりするくらい喜んだ
slides.scene: The owner's two hands lift the tiny puppy up into the air joyfully; the puppy's ears flop, happy.
slides.shot: close-up of hands raising the puppy

slides.text:
あの日の「そっか」が、
ぼくの安心になった
slides.scene: The tiny puppy asleep curled up in the owner's lap, the owner's hand resting on its back, soft lamplight.
slides.shot: close-up of lap and puppy

slides.text:
ぼくはあなたより
ずっと早く大人になる
slides.scene: The puppy sitting in a patch of afternoon sunlight on the floor, calm, looking out of the window.
slides.shot: medium shot, warm light

slides.text:
だから、ゆっくり
覚える時間をください
slides.scene: The puppy and the owner's hand side by side on the floor, the puppy's paw resting on one finger.
slides.shot: close-up of paw and finger

slides.text:
わからないのは、
わざとじゃないんだ
slides.scene: Close-up of the puppy's big honest eyes looking straight at the viewer, head slightly tilted.
slides.shot: close-up portrait

slides.text:
あなたの声で、
ちゃんと覚えていくから
slides.scene: The owner sits on the floor seen from behind, the puppy sitting upright in front of them, both facing each other, as if in a lesson.
slides.shot: from behind the owner

slides.text:
あなたの子が、はじめて
できたことは何でしたか？
slides.scene: Evening: the tiny puppy asleep on a small cushion next to the toilet tray corner, a soft blanket over it. No people.
slides.shot: medium shot, calm

caption:
わからないのは、わざとじゃない。
あなたの子がはじめてできたこと、教えてください。
youtube_title: はじめての日、ぼくが震えていた理由
self_review: 失敗を叱る場面は描かず、飼い主が落ち着いて教える形。別れの語なし。十戒『理解する時間をください』のテーマだけ借りている。
